setup: Crash and cancel around each named workflow/governance handoff.
assertion: Only WorkflowPendingObligationCommitted, GovernanceReservationCommitted, WorkflowActivationCommitted, and GovernanceOwnershipConfirmed are friend-visible barriers with complete immutable facts.

setup: Restart with immutable creation definition plus replayed resizes and debt.
assertion: Startup validates creation agreement without overwriting replayed current capacity or resize debt.

setup: Load malformed records and append partial, nonconsecutive, corrupt, or mutable batches.
assertion: Copies, format, checksum, complete 1..Version continuity, expected version, and consecutive whole batches are validated atomically.

setup: Queue contended single- and multi-pool requests.
assertion: FIFO arbitration grants every request atomically without bypass or partial ownership.

setup: Cancel at each of the four post-commit barriers and replay every command.
assertion: Each winner has one legal compensation/ownership result and stale commands are no-ops.

setup: Duplicate or alter partition, obligation, instance, generation, fiber, scope, token, version, ticket, pool, units, or provider generation facts.
assertion: Exact fact equality is required and no ghost or duplicate ticket can be created.
expectedRed: Complete immutable fact validation is absent.

setup: Release one obligation among unrelated held obligations.
assertion: Only its exact tickets restore capacity once; unrelated pools and obligations are unchanged.

setup: Release into a contended queue with eligible successors.
assertion: Capacity is conserved through direct transfer and every successor receives distinct tickets.

setup: Get or resize unknown pools and resize with zero/negative capacity.
assertion: Unknown GetAsync/ResizeAsync return the typed outcome; nonpositive resize throws before operation binding.

setup: Replay matching/conflicting operation IDs while shrinking below held units then releasing/transferring.
assertion: ResizeAsync has closed applied/conflict replay, preserves current capacity, and deterministically recomputes debt.

setup: Confirm, release, replay, restart, and purge retained obligations.
assertion: Confirmation bindings and tombstones conserve capacity and prevent ticket resurrection across replay.
